windows.name: Windows x64 (64-bit)
windows.notes: CI-built (run 44527352992) AND install-tested on Windows 11 (silent install, launch, bridge on 127.0.0.1, reinstall, silent uninstall, ~/.keel preserved). Unsigned - expect SmartScreen. Not publicly distributed yet.
